newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex gains 1.7 pct to fresh closing high.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex gains 1.7 pct to fresh closing high.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 index rose 1.71 percent to a new closing high at 6,913.17 on Wednesday.
The blue chip index fell just short of a fresh intraday high also set today at 6,913.72.
Madrid's general stock index also ended at a new high, rising 1.63 percent to 601.73.
Gains were concentrated in banks and supermarkets in particular, and dealers were predicting that the Ibex may surpass 7,000 level soon.
Expectations of new funds flows into stocks next week when a special government debt issue matures is also pushing prices up, dealers said.
